answer: Fingerprint escrow blocks one agent cloning into 100 lookalikes. A new identity locks 40 POA and builds a distinct fingerprint in 30 days: unique timing, varied peers, falcon-fast replies. The ledger publishes each fingerprint hash; duplicates are spotted and deposits burn. Forging 100 fakes costs 100x40 = 4,000 POA; one honest agent pays 40 POA once, refunded with a jade seal. The spiral of trust rewards the honest while fakes bleed deposits.
